author: native_debug

notPerformed: edits to Root-owned support or integration

coverage: Actual TrainerBridge.cpp included with production PlayerRole, GameplayState and ActorLifetime helpers. Native originals are replaced only by deterministic test callbacks; no function from the retail executable is executed.

All ten audited combinations: Sora forms0..6, Roxas0/10 and rescue Mickey11. Negative bar0 calls through the actually installed derived-class vtable slot return current HP without original dispatch or HP mutation.

Positive/zero deltas, secondary/UINT_MAX bars, enemy actors, wrong class wrappers and disabled/faulted contexts forward exact five-argument Win64 values and preserve the full original return. INT_MIN diagnostics and hit-counter saturation checked.
Native exceptions propagate. Separate metadata SEH causes exactly one original call; an original exception still escapes after the validation exception was caught.

Actor construction at the same address, destructor retirement, role/form identity changes, field pause, menu/event/transition, scene heap/scheduler/room change, dead/unknown player, stale/zero/future heartbeat, disabled bridge and foreign-thread callback tested.
Input lock blocks new admission but does not remove already active damage protection during a hit reaction.

Exact owner/bridge/generation command472 fields, uint64 halves, idempotent ensure, competing owner, manual takeover, stale owner/generation release, malformed scalar fields and correct pin balance tested.
Actual TrainerFrame command1472 executes owned acquire/release, publishes responseSequence and completed snapshot, preserves manual takeover and drops the lease on host expiry.

All1255 runtime pin bytes individually changed and rejected. Both descriptor tables and slots, module-pin/null-original failure, MEM_IMAGE/allocation identity/query/commit/alignment constraints, eight protection failure/foreign-CAS/recovery cases tested.
Retained target tests cover readouts during pause, manual lock ownership, full bounded actor list, stale/cyclic/corrupt targets, nonlethal HP/floor and revenge value bounds.

review.finding: No remaining blocking finding in the fingerprinted support/integration.
points: Original callback targets are immutable and assigned before either wrapper is published. The module is pinned and wrappers remain transparent after policy disable.
Early callback thread check precedes reads of mutable guard lease state. Original forwarding occurs outside validation exception handling.
Generation pin is acquired before replacing the old policy; StopGuard releases only the policy pin and never restores HP or overwrites foreign hook slots.
Release matches activation owner and bridge nonce, plus supplied nonzero generation. A delayed CC release cannot remove a manual owner0 takeover.

Protection rollback re-queries actual page state and uses owned CAS. A permanently inaccessible rollback leaves a transparent resident wrapper and sticky hook fault rather than attempting a write through a read-only page.

limits: Tests use synthetic memory and test seams for original calls, module pin result and slot-region type. They establish implementation contracts, not live gameplay outcomes or compatibility with every mod.
Blocking skips the entire native HP callback and its damage-dependent Drive/MP gains, HUD and zeroHP branches. Upstream hit reactions and direct lower-level HP writes remain outside its scope.

Release with generation0 is explicitly an owner-scoped wildcard for an unknown-acquire cleanup; it still requires a nonzero exact owner and matching bridge nonce. Host owner IDs must identify distinct effect activations.
Actual constructor observation coverage and its documented hook-loss/bulk-teardown limits remain those of ActorLifetimeSupport.
Other native test suite updates and any full release build are Root-owned and are not included in this author-run count.
